name.text: Q18. West route surcharge: baseline run

generalfeedback.text: Balanced total capacity and demand force West to ship 500 units in every feasible plan. The uniform surcharge therefore adds 500 x EUR 2 = EUR 1,000 to every feasible plan. name.text: Q20. West cap with North retained: specified run

questiontext.text: In Prescriptive Analytics Experiment 5, retain North capacity 300 with costs A/B/C/D=EUR 5/4/4/5 per unit. Keep East=600, West physical capacity=500 and original total demand=1,100. Change the West shipment limit from 500 to 400. Compare against the North-added reference cost of EUR 4,300. What happens?

generalfeedback.text: With North retained, effective capacity is 600+300+400=1,300 units. The LP remains feasible and minimum transport cost becomes EUR 4,400, an increase of EUR 100 relative to the North-added reference. Applying the same West cap without North would leave only 1,000 units of capacity and would be infeasible.
